item.title: Braun, Rokita Seek To Lift Order Blocking Ten Commandments Monument
item.description: Gov. Mike Braun and Attorney General Todd Rokita want a federal judge to lift a decades-old ban on the placement of a Ten Commandments monument at the Indiana Statehouse grounds.

item.title: Ruling Prevents Defund Of Consumer Financial Protection Bureau
item.description: A federal judge ruled Tuesday, Dec. 30 that the White House must continue funding the Consumer Financial Protection Bureau, rejecting a legal argument that could have left the agency without money to pay employees early next year.
